title: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions First Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical and Health Institutions First Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB MEDICAL AND HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
PUNJAB MEDICAL AND
HEALTH INSTITUTIONS
(FIRST AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2002
An Ordinance to
attend the Punjab Medical and Health Institutions Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 6th August, 2002]
No. Legis. 13-10/97, dated
6-8-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Medical and
Health Institutions (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
